# Drone Dash: round 16 critic report

**Verdict:** The job rules work: every city now gets the same kind of legs, and the city roll no longer sets the medal through tower roofs. But the round 15 test still fails. The same street pilot scores 1,695 to 9,066 on 12 fresh cities (5.3 times), and 838 to 1,695 on the same city run twice. The cause is now the clock, not the city. A run lives or dies at the third drop, which is always a rooftop. The margin is often one or two seconds. And the score roughly doubles with each extra delivery.

Build tested: working tree at commit 6dafbeb plus the uncommitted round 16 changes. Dev server port 5188 (stopped at the end). Scripts are copies of round 15 in `critic-scripts/`. Their output folder is the relative `../critic/`, so the copies write here with no edit. New scripts are listed at the end.

## Round 15 gap (the city roll decides the medal): not closed

12 fresh random cities, read from `__GAME__.city()` after loads with no `?seed` (`pick-seeds.log`), none found in the builder's round 16 scripts. Real time, one run at a time, `route-play-rt-x-m-esc.mjs` (street) and `balance-probe-m-esc.mjs` (lazy), SIMT 600.

| City | Mood, parks | Street | Drops, run | Lazy | Same street bot, deterministic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 80258 | Golden hour, 2 | 3,882 Silver | 3, 126 s | 1,417 Bronze | 3,830 (3) |
| 40443 | Bright morning, 4 | 7,505 Gold | 5, 170 s | 1,398 Bronze | 7,371 (5) |
| 66012 | Hazy noon, 2 | 5,589 Silver | 4, 145 s | 1,469 Bronze | 7,355 (5) |
| 97343 | Hazy noon, 4 | 7,576 Gold | 5, 165 s | 1,318 Bronze | 7,718 (5) |
| 73243 | Hazy noon, 4 | 8,791 Gold | 5, 174 s | 510 | **11,041 Ace** (6) |
| 12668 | Rose dusk, 4 | 3,668 Silver | 3, 121 s | 595 | 2,458 (2) |
| 96842 | Rose dusk, 3 | 4,223 Silver | 3, 126 s | 589 | 4,215 (3) |
| 54408 | Golden hour, 4 | 3,436 Silver | 3, 118 s | 344 | 1,832 (2) |
| 19093 | Hazy noon, 2 | 3,862 Silver | 3, 123 s | 299 | 2,458 (2) |
| 84143 | Hazy noon, 4 | 9,066 Gold | 5, 178 s | 489 | 9,277 (5) |
| 62367 | Hazy noon, 4 | **1,695 Bronze** | 2, 88 s | 342 | 1,689 (2) |
| 36020 | Rose dusk, 4 | **1,960 Bronze** | 2, 96 s | 586 | 1,957 (2) |

| Test | Needed | Result | Pass |
|---|---|---|---|
| Street Silver or better | 12 of 12 | 10 of 12 (62367 and 36020 Bronze) | No |
| Lazy Bronze or below | 12 of 12 | 12 of 12 (best 1,469) | Yes |
| No bot at Ace | none | Real time none (best 9,066). The deterministic street bot made Ace on 73243 (11,041) | Yes in the test, but close |
| Best lazy at least 300 below worst street | 300 | 1,469 vs 1,695: **226** | No |
| Street best / worst | at most 2.5 | 9,066 / 1,695 = **5.35** (round 15: 6.1) | No |

Same-city repeats in real time (`rep-low.log`): 62367 scored 1,695, then 1,675, then **838** (one drop). 36020 scored 1,960 twice. 54408 scored 3,436, then **1,960** (and 1,832 deterministic). So 54408 is a third Bronze city about half the time.

What did improve: leg lengths are now uniform. On all 12 cities, pickups are 45 to 105 m of street and drops are 106 to 198 m. Every third drop is a rooftop at 16 to 29 m (`reach16-low.log`, `legs-*.log`). No first leg goes up a tower. Draftable street frontage is the same on every city (91 to 97 percent of road within reach of a wall, `frontage16.log`). The city itself is no longer the problem.

## Outliers: why

Street score by deliveries made, all 28 street runs on the 12 cities: 1 drop 838. 2 drops 1,675 to 2,458. 3 drops 3,436 to 4,223. 4 drops 5,348 to 5,589. 5 drops 7,355 to 9,277. 6 drops 11,041. Each delivery is worth more than the last (combo x1.5 to x3.5, street bonus paid only on a drop, time bonus per drop). So one missed drop near the end costs 40 to 50 percent of the score.

Where runs end (deterministic, `route-legs16.mjs`, screenshot 0.5 s before time-up):
- 5 of 12 deterministic runs end on drop 3, the rooftop. 4 of those end 13 to 31 m from the pad (12668 30 m, 54408 13 m, 19093 31 m, 36020 17 m).
- 4 more end 6 to 14 m from the next stop (96842 6 m, 40443 14 m, 66012 14 m, 97343 14 m).
- **62367** (O-low-seed62367-timeout): the bot picks up at a depot with 1 s left, and the game hands it a 29 m rooftop 158 m away. Its first two legs were slow (88 m in 18.1 s and 134 m in 22.9 s, against 7 to 15 s on other cities). It earned only 9.5 to 12.3 s of slow clock in a run (best cities 50 s). The bot climbs to 26 m to leave off-road depot pads. It also brakes to 7 m/s at every corner. So legs with three corners cost it more than they would cost a human.
- **36020** (O-low-seed36020-timeout): 18 m short of the third drop, a rooftop, with 1 s left and +697 street bonus banked and lost.
- **54408 and 19093**: the same rooftop on drop 3, 13 and 31 m short in the deterministic run. In real time they made it by a second or two and scored 3,436 and 3,862.
- No crashes in any of the 28 street runs. No stuck bot (0 unstick episodes logged).

**Game or bot?** Mostly the game. The bot is slow on some corners and depots, but that only decides which runs fall off the cliff. The cliff itself is the game. Every run must reach a fixed rooftop on drop 3 at about 95 to 100 s. The clock has no grace. The score compounds with deliveries. A human of steady skill will meet the same edge, and will see "Parcel secured! Now deliver it" with 1 s left and a 158 m job, then lose the banked bonus. A few hundred milliseconds of noise moves the same pilot on the same city between medals. Examples: Bronze and Silver (62367, 54408), Gold and Ace (73243).

## Gates on seeds 22, 58, 130 (real time, one pass)

| Run | Seed 22 | Seed 58 | Seed 130 | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Low (music-run) | 4,078 Silver, 3 drops | 4,982 Silver, 4 | 5,451 Silver, 4 | 14,511 |
| High | 5,350 Silver, 6 | 3,020 Silver, 5 | 3,158 Silver, 5 | 11,528 |
| Lazy | 582 | 1,236 Bronze | 681 | 2,499 |

- Low / high **1.26** (needed 0.85). The street line now beats the beeline (round 15: 0.95). No Gold on these seeds under the new 6,000 line.
- Breakdown exact: diagnostics, game-over rows and total agree in all 9 runs here and all 28 runs on random cities (bdOk and domOk true). The game-over card splits fast drops and rush orders, and they add up.
- Rush hour starts at 60.0 s in all 30 runs that passed 60 s (ESC lines), stage 2 after 120 s.
- No-delivery farms: all 30 (farm-probe 8, farm-loop, smart-farm near, line, pickup, pickupline, spendpickup) score **0**. Capfarm points a minute over the 3 seeds: honest 2,158, carry 777 (**0.36**), both 0. The carry farm on seed 22 still delivers twice and gets Silver (2,830), as in round 15. Pass.

## Daily city: works

Seed 45900 on two loads and in a fresh profile, same first parcel. Mocked 16 Oct gives 68757, 31 Dec gives 75412. A daily run of 1,220 saved as "Daily best 1,220 Bronze, New daily best!". A random-city run of 2,905 raised the overall best and left the daily best at 1,220. Two daily attempts get the same 4 parcels in order. On iPhone the title buttons are still 25 px tall.

## City audit: 24 fresh cities, nothing broken

Seeds 94168, 54344, 26595, 76487, 60851, 35255, 71248, 78143, 86757, 37625, 29902, 83343, 12982, 89030, 33443, 94748, 98918, 99195, 77231, 20180, 81397, 46053, 62130, 41816. `city-audit16.mjs` builds each city with its own park count. 0 broken pads (buried, overhang, awning, too high, outside, far from road), builder padAudit 0. 0 spawns inside geometry, 0 crashes or drift in 3 s with no input. First pickup 38 to 81 m straight line. Park count matches the look in 24 of 24 (2 to 4). Moods across 40 loads: Hazy noon 17, Golden hour 9, Rose dusk 9, Bright morning 5.

## Regressions

- **Crash-classify, 8 seeds:** 12 m: 645 s, 20 drops, 56 charged, **0 hop-like**, 9 near the target, **0 on a pad lip**. All near-target hits were faces 7.8 to 25.7 m below the top (N-alt12-seed33-t55.4: the side of a taller tower beside a 26 m rooftop pad). 20 m: 659 s, 25 drops, 37 charged, **0 hop-like**, 7 near, 0 pad lip, faces 4.3 to 25.8 m below the top. 12 crashes rose afterwards, all with climb held (bot climbing or unsticking). Two clipped an edge 1.2 and 1.5 m below the top while climbing over it (seed 58). Real wall hits. The 12 m beeline crashes more than last round (5.2 a minute, was 3.9), likely because drops are now longer.
- **Flat-frame probe:** 1,039 frames, 0 flat, 0 errors.
- **Music:** adaptive. Chain 0 to 3 gives 1 to 4 layers, mean intensity 0.33 to 0.89. Final section from 9.96 to 9.99 s left. 0 late notes, 0 resyncs, 0 errors.
- **Hand-fly first payout:** desktop 7.2 s, mobile **9.9 s** (round 15: 5.5 and 8.7). Both within 10 s, mobile by 0.1 s.

## As a player (desktop and iPhone 13 held sideways, touch)

- **Do cities feel different?** Yes, more than last round. Rose dusk is purple and pink with a low sun. Hazy noon has a teal sea and flat light. Bright morning is blue and cool. Golden hour is the old look. The first look from the title now tells you a new place. Parks vary 2 to 4 but you rarely notice. The grid, the buildings and the props are still the same. The title still says "Golden-hour courier" on a rose dusk city (L-d-seed12668-title).
- **New medal lines.** Bronze 1,000 comes on the first or second drop. Silver 2,500 needs three drops, Gold 6,000 needs five. That ladder is readable and reachable for a good pilot, and Gold is a real goal. But the medal you get depends on whether you reach the third drop with a second to spare. Missing it by a building width turns Silver into Bronze and leaves +700 unpaid on screen. That feels unfair, not motivating. Ace 10,000 needs six drops, which a deterministic bot already did.
- **HUD.** On iPhone the "High wind" chip covers the pickup distance label (L-m-seed12668-flight). The rush banner still sits on top of the crash pop (N-alt12-seed33-t55.4). Delivery pops stack over the drone.

## Whole game, against the best polished indie arcade flying and delivery games

- **First 10 seconds:** strong. Now four looks, each warm and coherent.
- **Onboarding:** good. First payout within 10 s on both devices, but mobile is at the edge.
- **Core loop:** pick up, draft, deliver, chain. The street line now beats the beeline (1.26). Leg lengths are fair.
- **Game feel:** still the best part. Momentum, banking, camera lean.
- **Art:** coherent and finished, with real variety in light now.
- **Audio:** adaptive and clean.
- **UI:** clean, with a few overlaps at busy moments.
- **Difficulty curve:** the clock decides everything around drop 3. The best arcade delivery games also end a run on a clock. But there you keep what you earned. The last seconds feel like a sprint you can win. Here the last seconds often hand you a job you cannot finish and take away banked points.
- **Replay pull:** daily city and four moods help. Medals still swing too much run to run to mean skill.

## Single biggest remaining gap: the run ends on a knife edge at the third drop

**The concern.** Run length is set by the clock, the clock is fed by drops, and the score compounds with drops. Every city now has the same legs, so every run hits the same wall. The third drop is a rooftop, reached at about 95 to 100 s. Either the pilot makes it with a second to spare, or the run ends 6 to 30 m short and the banked street bonus is lost. One drop more or less moves the score 40 to 50 percent. So the same pilot on the same city swings between medals, and the spread across cities stays near 5 times.

**Evidence:**
- Street bot on 12 cities: 1,695 to 9,066 (5.35 times). Silver 10 of 12.
- Same city, same bot: 62367 838 to 1,695. 54408 1,832 to 3,436. 66012 5,589 to 7,355. 73243 8,791 to 11,041.
- 9 of 12 deterministic runs end within 31 m of the next stop. 5 of 12 end on drop 3, the rooftop.
- Score by drops: 2 drops at most 2,458, 3 drops at least 3,436.
- Best lazy 1,469 (it gets a +150 rush order on two drops) is 226 below the worst street run.

**Acceptance test.** Dev server 5188. 12 fresh random seeds not used for tuning. `critic-scripts/route-play-rt-x-m-esc.mjs` (street, real time) and `balance-probe-m-esc.mjs` (lazy), plus `route-legs16.mjs` (deterministic).
1. Street bot Silver or better on 12 of 12. Lazy Bronze or below on 12 of 12. No bot at Ace, deterministic included.
2. Best lazy at least 300 below worst street. Street best / worst at most 2.5.
3. Same-city noise: 3 real-time street runs on each of 4 of those cities (the two lowest and two highest). On each city, best / worst at most 1.4.
4. In the deterministic runs, at most 3 of 12 end within 30 m of the next stop. Or: a run that ends that close keeps at least half of its banked street bonus.
5. Seeds 22, 58, 130 still pass the round 14 and 15 gates, no-delivery farms 0.

The fix is the builder's choice. Examples:
- a short overtime to finish the leg in hand;
- a time bonus sized to the next leg, so a fresh job is never impossible;
- no rooftop on drop 3 when the clock is low;
- part of the banked bonus paid at time-up;
- a flatter combo.

## Other gaps (ranked)

1. **Busy-moment overlaps.** Rush banner over the crash pop (N-alt12-seed33-t55.4). On iPhone the wind chip over the nav distance (L-m-seed12668-flight). Delivery pops over the drone (M-low-seed40443-pass3). Test: in a full run on desktop and iPhone held sideways, no two centre pops overlap and nothing covers the objective pill or nav label.
2. **Title on mobile and mood text.** City buttons 25 px tall on iPhone 13 held sideways (round 15 asked for 40 px). "Golden-hour courier" shows on every mood. Test: buttons at least 40 px tall, tagline matches the mood.
3. **Ace is one good run away for a bot.** Deterministic street bot 11,041 on 73243. Ace is meant for skilled humans. Test: with the fix above, no bot over 9,500 on 12 cities, and a skilled desktop journey within 1,000 of Ace.
4. **Mobile first payout at 9.9 s.** Was 8.7. Test: hand-fly mobile first payout at most 8 s.
5. **The world is still one grid.** Light changes, layout and props do not, and nothing changes in the world at 60 s. Test: 6 fresh loads show at least 3 district mixes a player can name, and rush hour changes something visible.

## Performance

Headless Chromium caps at 120 Hz (8.3 ms).
- Hand-fly desktop 1280x720: 9,566 frames, **median 8.30 ms, p95 9.20, max 25.6, 2 over 20 ms**.
- Hand-fly iPhone 13 held sideways, touch: 9,580 frames, median 8.30, p95 9.10, max 9.4, 0 over 20 ms.
- First load, production build to a scratch folder: **about 0.79 MB** (JS 742 KB, 199 KB gzipped. CSS 34 KB. HTML 10 KB). lil-gui 31 KB only for `?debug`. Budget 15 MB: pass.
- Page errors: 0 in every run.

## Screenshots (progress/round-16/critic/)

- Outliers at time-up (deterministic, 0.5 s before the end): O-low-seed62367-timeout, O-low-seed36020-timeout, and O-low-seed* for all 12 cities.
- Outlier medal moments: M-low-seed62367-pass1, M-low-seed36020-pass1. All medal passes: M-low-*, M-high-*, M-low-c10-*.
- Moods, desktop and iPhone: L-d-seed80258 (Golden hour), L-d-seed40443 (Bright morning), L-d-seed66012 (Hazy noon), L-d-seed12668 (Rose dusk), each -title and -flight, and the same as L-m-*.
- Crashes near the target: N-alt12-*, N-alt20-*. Bot crash shots: Q-*.
- City audit starts: V-city*-start. Farms: F-farm-*, S-smartfarm-*, C-capfarm-*. Hand-fly: d-h*, m-h*. Daily: D-*.

## Scripts and logs (progress/round-16/critic-scripts/)

- Copies of all round 15 scripts, unchanged.
- New scripts:
  - `pick-seeds.mjs`: random seeds with mood and parks.
  - `city-audit16.mjs`: city-audit with each city's own park count.
  - `reach16.mjs`: reach-probe plus leg street distance and height.
  - `route-legs16.mjs`: route-play with the external clock, per-leg times and clock, time-up shot.
  - `frontage16.mjs`: draftable street frontage.
  - `looks16.mjs`: mood shots.
  - `det16.sh`, `queue16.sh`, `repeat16.sh`.
- Note: route-play.mjs, reach-probe.mjs and crash-classify-v.mjs do not switch on the external clock, so the game loop also runs in real time. Their leg times and scores are not deterministic. route-legs16.mjs fixes that. Leg geometry from reach16 is still right, since the parcel order depends on the seed only.
- Logs: acc-low, acc-lazy (acceptance), rep-low (repeats), legs-a to d, reach16-low, frontage16, m-low-a, m-high-a, m-lazy-a, ccv12, ccv20, farm-*, farmloop-22, smart-*, capfarm-*, city-audit, daily, hf-desktop, hf-mobile, flat, looks16, pick-seeds.
- Order: deterministic batch first, then real-time queue one at a time, then deterministic leg runs, then real-time repeats alone.
builder.md
# Drone Dash, round 16 builder: fair cities

Concern from the round 15 critic: the city roll decides the medal more than flying skill. The same street bot scored 1,178 to 7,208 on 9 cities (6.1 times).

**Result in one line:** the job sequence is now the same on every city, and the 9 old cities measure alike. On 12 fresh cities the lazy-bot checks pass, but the street bot still spreads 2,196 to 10,729 (4.9 times). Two runs reached Ace and two ended under Silver. The cause is now different. It is not the city. It is how long the run lasts (the clock snowball). Not fixed in the time box. See "What is left".

Note on the session: the Mac slept during the first attempt. The time box restarted at 18:29. All numbers below come from after the restart.

## 1. Measurement (why the city decided the medal)

`builder-scripts/city-measure.mjs` runs the game's own generator and DeliverySystem in Node (vite `ssrLoadModule`). It walks a ghost through the first 8 objectives. The job sequence does not depend on how the drone flies, so this is exact. For each leg it logs the straight distance, the street (grid) distance, the target kind and the target height. It also logs the draft-wall share. This is the share of 4 m samples on the street bot's L route that have a solid building face within 10 m at 7 m height. Logs: `builder/measure-before.log` (old code), `measure-after.log`, `measure-fresh.log`.

Before (old job picker, first 4 objectives):

| City | Street score r15 | First pickup | First-4 street m | First-4 climb m | Roof legs in first 4 | Mean wall share |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 22 | 7,208 | roof 7 m, 37 m | 460 | 0 | 1 | 0.70 |
| 73023 | 6,781 | roof 13 m, 101 m | 466 | 19 | 2 | 0.70 |
| 130 | 4,777 | roof 20 m, 59 m | 510 | 13 | 1 | 0.74 |
| 57366 | 4,495 | roof 10 m, 48 m | 384 | 3 | 1 | 0.73 |
| 32730 | 4,017 | roof 7 m, 102 m | 536 | 35 | 2 | 0.68 |
| 81401 | 2,690 | roof 7 m, 100 m | 493 | 0 | 1 | 0.73 |
| 58 | 2,219 | roof 16 m, 67 m | 398 | 18 | 2 | 0.76 |
| 48684 | 1,970 | roof 7 m, 58 m | 429 | 16 | 2 | 0.74 |
| 70492 | 1,178 | roof 16 m, 45 m | 420 | **69** | **3** | 0.73 |

Causes found:
- **Rooftop climbs early in the run.** The first pickup was always a rooftop. The spawn rule allowed only a depot, park or roof, and roofs won the clear-line test. Drops took any kind 55% of the time, so a tower-heavy city sent the street pilot up 33 to 42 m roofs. On 70492 the first 4 legs held 69 m of climb and 3 roofs. The street bot's mean height there was 16.5 m (9 to 10 m on good cities). That is above most of the draft, so the bot lost both drafting and clock.
- **Leg length came from straight distance, not street distance.** Some cities opened with 300 m of street before the first drop (81401: 140 m + 170 m). The street pilot flies the grid, so a long grid leg costs clock the drop bonus does not repay.
- **Wall share was not the main driver before.** It was 0.68 to 0.76 on all 9 cities. It does matter for the leftover spread (section 4).

## 2. Design

### Job sequence (src/systems/DeliverySystem.ts, `JOBS`, `jobSpec`, `pickLeg`)
Every leg follows one spec on every city. Street distance is the grid distance from the last stop:
- **First pickup:** 45 to 95 m of street, a pad at most 12 m up, any kind. A clear straight line from the spawn is still preferred.
- **Pickups:** 45 to 105 m of street, at most 16 m up.
- **Drops:** 105 to 165 m of street, growing 6 m per delivery (up to 150 to 225 m). Drops are at street level: 70% shop doorsteps, the rest any street pad. The exception: **every third drop is a rooftop between 9 and 24 m** (+4 m per delivery, at most 40 m).
- If no site fits, the band widens in 15% steps. Then the kind and height rules go, with a height limit of 15 m over the spec. Then any site. The clear-approach check is a preference inside each step, as before.
- The objective RNG is still the only random source, so `?seed=N` and the daily city stay deterministic. The parcel order changes on every seed, including the 8 regression seeds.

After (same 9 cities): every first pickup is low (0.4 to 7 m), and first-4 climb is **0 on all 9**. First-4 street is 395 to 486 m (before 384 to 536). Mean drop street distance is 131 to 170 m. On 12 fresh cities: first-4 street 410 to 477 m, climb 0, 1 or 2 roof legs in the first 8.

### Medal lines (src/game/config.ts, GOALS)
With no early tower climbs, the street bot makes 4 to 5 drops instead of 1 to 2. On my 4 tuning cities (70492, 48684, 81401, 58), the street bot scored 4,945 to 8,891 and the lazy bot 1,210 to 1,637. New lines: **Bronze 1,000 (same), Silver 2,500 (was 1,650), Gold 6,000 (was 4,500), Ace 10,000 (was 8,500).**

### City looks (cheap, in the existing art style)
- `cities.cityLook(seed)` uses a separate hash of the seed. It never touches the layout or parcel RNG. It picks:
  - **a light mood**, one of 4: Golden hour (the original), Bright morning, Rose dusk, Hazy noon. `Environment.applyMood` rewrites PALETTE and SUN_DIR before the sky, fog and lights are built. The sky shader, fog, background, baked environment light, sun colour and direction, and hemisphere fill all follow. There is no new geometry and no new draw calls.
  - **2 to 4 parks** (was always 3). It passes through `generateCity(rng, 7, parks)`. With 3 parks the layout is byte-identical to before.
- Spread over 10,000 seeds: moods 24 to 25% each, parks 2/3/4 a third each.
- Diagnostics: `city.mood`, `city.parks`.
- Screenshots: `builder-shots/L-*-title.jpg` and `L-*-play.jpg`. Seeds 11 Golden hour, 22 Bright morning, 33 Rose dusk, 58 Hazy noon.
- **Regression seeds:** 22, 58, 130, 11 and 91 keep 3 parks, so their layout is unchanged (only their light mood changes). **Seeds 7 and 33 now have 2 parks and seed 44 has 4.** Those three layouts changed. Of the critic's random cities, 70492, 48684, 32730 and 73023 now have 2 parks and 81401 has 4, so they are not the cities the critic flew.
- **Script note:** the critic's `city-audit.mjs` rebuilds the city with `generateCity(createSeededRandom(seed))`, which means 3 parks. On 2 or 4 park cities, its spawn check compares the real spawn against the wrong layout. It reported 4 false "spawnHit" out of 30. `builder-scripts/city-audit16.mjs` is the same script with one change: it passes `cityLook(seed).parks`. The in-game `__GAME__.padAudit` hook already does this. I did not get to run `city-audit16.mjs` (time).

## 3. Acceptance on 12 fresh cities (never tuned on)

Seeds (crypto random, `builder/fresh-seeds.txt`): 38538, 38820, 80628, 61714, 48173, 22265, 36686, 22415, 26338, 59413, 25355, 73421. Real time, one script at a time, SIMT 600. Logs: `builder/f-low.log`, `builder/f-lazy.log`.

| City | Look | Street (low) bot | Drops | Run s | Lazy bot | Wall share (8 legs) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 38538 | 4 parks | 5,359 Silver | 4 | 147 | 1,568 Bronze | 0.74 |
| 38820 | | **10,704 Ace** | 6 | 197 | 1,383 Bronze | 0.73 |
| 80628 | 4 parks | 2,947 Silver | 3 | 110 | 1,256 Bronze | 0.61 |
| 61714 | 2 parks | **2,298 Bronze** | 2 | 89 | 460 none | 0.73 |
| 48173 | 2 parks | **10,729 Ace** | 6 | 196 | 331 none | 0.69 |
| 22265 | | **2,196 Bronze** | 2 | 92 | 452 none | 0.59 |
| 36686 | 2 parks | 9,379 Gold | 5 | 176 | 644 none | 0.72 |
| 22415 | 2 parks | 8,490 Gold | 5 | 176 | 1,619 Bronze | 0.68 |
| 26338 | 4 parks | 3,959 Silver | 3 | 125 | 1,413 Bronze | 0.66 |
| 59413 | 4 parks | 5,351 Silver | 4 | 137 | 1,400 Bronze | 0.64 |
| 25355 | 4 parks | 3,524 Silver | 3 | 119 | 491 none | 0.72 |
| 73421 | 4 parks | 2,592 Silver | 2 | 103 | 566 none | 0.70 |

| Check | Needed | Result | Pass |
|---|---|---|---|
| Street Silver or better | 12 of 12 | 10 of 12 (61714 2,298 and 22265 2,196 are Bronze) | **No** |
| Lazy Bronze or below | 12 of 12 | 12 of 12 (best 1,619) | Yes |
| No bot at Ace | 0 | 2 street runs over 10,000 (10,704 and 10,729) | **No** |
| Best lazy at least 300 below worst street | 300 | 2,196 - 1,619 = **577** | Yes |
| Street best / worst | at most 2.5 | 10,729 / 2,196 = **4.9** (was 6.1) | **No** |

Breakdown exact (bdOk and domOk) in 12 of 12 street runs and 12 of 12 lazy runs. Rush hour showed in every run that passed 60 s.

## 4. What is left: the clock snowball, not the city

The score is almost a function of the number of drops:
- 2 drops: 2,196 to 2,592
- 3 drops: 2,947 to 3,959
- 4 drops: 4,945 to 5,359
- 5 drops: 7,797 to 9,379
- 6 drops: 10,704 to 10,729

The number of drops comes from run length: 50 s, plus drop time, plus slow-clock time. A good run earns clock faster than it spends it (6 drops, 92 s drop time, 51 to 55 s slow clock, 196 s). A run that misses one leg ends at about 90 s with 2 drops (26 s drop time, 15 s slow clock). The job sequence is now flat across cities, but this knife edge stays. Two signs that it is partly run noise rather than city:
- The lazy bot scored only 331 on 48173, where the street bot hit 10,729.
- The tuning runs on 70492, 48684 and 81401 all landed at 5 drops.

One city trait still shows: the two cities with the lowest route wall share (22265 at 0.59, 80628 at 0.61) both gave short street runs. Less wall means less slow clock.

Proposed next steps (not done, all small):
1. **Prefer drop legs with a draft wall.** `pickLeg` can rank candidates by route wall share. The measure already exists in `city-measure.mjs`. It costs about 40 collider samples per pick. Aim for at least 6 of 8 legs at 0.6 or more on every city.
2. **Compress run length.** Steeper `clockDecay` (for example 1 - 0.08 per drop, floor 0.4, was 0.035 and 0.55) plus about +8 s start time. Weak runs get a third drop and strong runs stop near 5.
3. **Flatten the per-drop snowball.** Cap the combo at x2.5 (now x3.5). Or pay the street bonus at a flat rate per leg.
4. Then recalibrate the medals on 4 to 6 tuning cities and re-test on 12 new fresh seeds.

I did not tune the medal lines on the fresh seeds. A Silver of 2,000 and an Ace of 11,000 pass the medal rows here, but that is fitting the test. The 2.5 times ratio still fails with any medal lines.

## 5. Gates and regressions

Deterministic checks ran before the real-time queue (logs in `builder/` and `builder-scripts/`):
- **No-delivery farms:** 30 of 30 score **0** (farm-probe 8, farm-loop, smart-farm 21 on 22, 58, 130).
- **Capfarm:** honest 4,017 / 5,188 / 5,747 (2,158 a minute over 416 s). Carry 2,830 / 0 / 0 (777 a minute, **0.36**). Both 0 / 0 / 0 (**0**). Under 0.5: pass.
- **Crash-classify-v, 8 seeds** (`ccv12.log`, `ccv20.log`):
  - 12 m: 624 s, 18 drops, 60 charged, **0 hop-like**. 9 near the target: every one a building face 2.9 to 25.6 m above the drone (tops 14.5 to 52 m, pad heights 0.4 to 26 m). **0 on a pad lip.**
  - 20 m: 642 s, 25 drops, 43 charged. **1 hop-like** (seed 44 at 61.4 s, 66 m from the target, 3.2 m under a 23.4 m top, rose 1.0 m). This is the same kind as the round 15 builder's case. **0 on a pad lip.** Closest near-target: seed 58 at 34.4 s, 1.2 m under a 22.1 m face, target a street doorstep.
  - The 12 m crash count rose (60, was 48). More street-level drops mean more low flying among trees and lamps. These bots fly a fixed height.
- **Pad audit, 30 fresh random cities** (`city-audit.log`, the game's own `padAudit` with the right park count): **0 broken pads.** The critic's own audit in that script also found 0 pad issues, and 0 spawn crashes in 3 s. Its 4 "spawnHit" are the 3-park layout mismatch described above.
- **Build:** `tsc` clean. Production build to a scratch folder: JS 742 KB (201.5 KB gzip), CSS 34 KB, HTML 10 KB. First load about **0.79 MB**. lil-gui is still a separate chunk.
- **Bloom clamps** in ObjectiveMarker: untouched. **Debug hooks:** all kept. `padAudit` now uses each seed's park count.

Real-time queue after the acceptance runs (`builder-scripts/queue16.sh`, `builder/queue16.log`): see the "Queue tail" section below.

## Files changed

- `src/systems/DeliverySystem.ts`: `JOBS`, `jobSpec`, `pickLeg`. Replaces `choose`, the old straight-distance picker.
- `src/game/config.ts`: medal lines.
- `src/game/cities.ts`: `cityLook(seed)`.
- `src/world/Environment.ts`: `MOODS`, `applyMood`. LightingRig takes a mood.
- `src/world/CityGenerator.ts`: `parks` parameter (default 3).
- `src/game/Game.ts`: applies the look, passes the park count (also in the `padAudit` hook), adds `city.mood` and `city.parks` to diagnostics.
- `src/vite-env.d.ts`: diagnostics type.
- `progress/round-16/builder-scripts/`: copies of the round 15 critic scripts (output folder changed to `../builder-shots/`). New: `city-measure.mjs`, `look-shots.mjs`, `city-audit16.mjs`, `queue16.sh`.

## Queue tail (real time, one at a time, after the acceptance runs)

- **Hand-fly:**
  - Desktop: first draft 4.7 s, first payout **6.7 s** (+25). 9,578 frames, median 8.30 ms, **p95 9.80**, max 16.7, 0 over 20 ms.
  - Mobile: first draft 5.2 s, first payout **9.8 s** (+25, inside 10 s but close). 7,991 frames, p95 10.0, max 10.5.
  - 0 errors on both.
- **Flat-frame probe:** 978 frames, 0 flat, 0 errors.
- **Round 14 and 15 gates on 22, 58, 130 (SIMT 600):**

| Run | Seed 22 | Seed 58 | Seed 130 | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Low (music-run) | 4,088 Silver | 3,630 Silver | 5,832 Silver | 13,550 |
| High | 5,707 Silver | 2,994 Silver | 5,893 Silver | 14,594 |
| Lazy | 582 none | 1,230 Bronze | 434 none | |

  - Low / high **0.93** (needed 0.85). Breakdown exact (bdOk, domOk) in 9 of 9.
  - Rush hour started at 60 s in 3 of 3 low runs and shows in diagnostics.
  - Music adaptive: chain 0 to 2 gives 1 to 3 layers.
  - With the new Gold line (6,000), no gate run reached Gold.
  - Best lazy 1,230 is 2,400 below the worst low run.
- **Not run (time):**
  - a daily-city check this round (`cities.ts` daily code is unchanged)
  - `city-audit16.mjs`
  - a same-city repeat test to split city effect from run noise

critic.md
# Drone Dash: round 15 critic report

**Verdict:** Random cities, the daily city and rush hour all work, and every round 14 gate still passes on seeds 22, 58 and 130. But random cities exposed a new problem: the city you roll now decides your medal more than how you fly. The same street pilot scores 1,178 (Bronze) to 7,208 (Gold), city by city. On a hard city it scores less than the lazy pilot on an easy one.

Build tested: working tree at commit 2165a53 plus the uncommitted round 15 changes. Dev server port 5188 (stopped at the end). Scripts are copies of round 14 in `critic-scripts/`. Their output folder is the relative `../critic/`, so the copies write here with no edit. New scripts are listed at the end.

## Round 14 gap (every run was the same run): closed in the letter, partly in the spirit

| Check | Needed | Result | Pass |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fresh loads differ | 2 of 3 | `variety-probe`: 3 of 3 different fingerprints (941f2d2d, de0db502, d5e70f4a), 80 / 96 / 82 sites, 3 different first pickups. `city-audit`: 24 fresh loads gave 24 different seeds | Yes |
| Daily city | same on a day, differs on another date, own best | Seed 45900 on two loads and in a fresh profile, same first parcel. Mocked 16 Oct gives 68757, 31 Dec gives 75412. A daily run of 1,127 saved as "Daily best 1,127 Bronze, New daily best!". A later random-city run of 3,061 raised the overall best but left the daily best at 1,127. The next day shows daily best 0. Two daily attempts get the same 4 parcels in the same order | Yes |
| New element after 60 s, in diagnostics | 3 of 3 low runs | Rush hour starts at 60.0 s in 3 of 3 (and in all 33 bot runs that lasted past 60 s). Diagnostics: `escalation.on` true, `startedAt` 60, stage 1, then stage 2 after 120 s. Orders 1 to 3, made 1 to 2 | Yes |

In spirit: every city is the same 7 by 7 street grid, with roads at the same coordinates. Every city has exactly 3 parks and 6 depot pads. The sky, palette and sea never change. What changes is which buildings stand where (1 to 10 towers, tallest 59 to 120 m) and where the pads are. It reads as the same city rearranged, not a new place. Rush hour is a coral tag and +150 on 1 to 3 parcels a run. Nothing in the world changes at 60 s.

## Round 14 gates on seeds 22, 58, 130 (one pass, real time, SIMT 600)

| Run | Seed 22 | Seed 58 | Seed 130 | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Low (music-run) | 7,208 Gold, 159 s, rush +300 | 2,219 Silver, 94 s, rush +150 | 4,777 Gold, 130 s, rush +150 | 14,204 |
| High | 6,101 Gold, rush +450 | 4,253 Silver, rush +150 | 4,529 Gold, rush +300 | 14,883 |
| Lazy | 506 none | 579 none | 640 none | 1,725 |

- Low / high 0.95 (needed 0.85). Low Silver 3 of 3, Gold 2. High Silver or better 3 of 3. No Ace (best 7,208, 1,292 short). Lazy no medal 3 of 3. Pass.
- Breakdown exact in 9 of 9 runs (diagnostics, game-over rows and total agree. The new "Rush orders 2 of 3 in time" row adds up).
- Best lazy 640, worst street 2,219: gap 1,579. Silver 1,650 sits 1,010 above lazy and 569 below street. Pass.
- Rush closed round 14's Gold knife edge on low seed 130 (4,455 then, 4,777 now) but made a new one: high seed 130 is 29 over Gold.
- No-delivery farms: all 30 (farm-probe 8, farm-loop, smart-farm near, line, pickup, pickupline, spendpickup on 22, 58, 130) score **0**. Capfarm: honest 2,180 a minute, carry 953 (0.44), both 844 (0.39). Pass.

## Generalisation: 6 random cities of my choosing (81401, 70492, 32730, 48684, 57366, 73023)

| City | Low (street) | High (beeline at 40 m) | Lazy |
|---|---|---|---|
| 81401 | 2,690 Silver | 4,625 Gold | 0 |
| 70492 | **1,178 Bronze** | 4,525 Gold | 657 |
| 32730 | 4,017 Silver | 2,636 Silver | 424 |
| 48684 | 1,970 Silver | 3,779 Silver | 325 |
| 57366 | 4,495 Silver (5 short of Gold) | 3,346 Silver | **1,414 Bronze** (incl. a +150 rush) |
| 73023 | 6,781 Gold | 3,595 Silver | 645 |
| Total | 21,131 | 22,506 | 3,465 |

- Street Silver or better: **5 of 6. Fails on 70492** (one delivery in 81 s). It is a tower-heavy city: 21 rooftop pads, tallest 120 m, and the first parcel goes to a tower roof.
- Lazy Bronze or below 6 of 6. No Ace. Pass.
- Best lazy (1,414) is **236 above** the worst street run (1,178). The 300-point gap fails on random cities.
- High Silver or better 6 of 6, Gold 2, with only 25 to 201 street-bonus points a run.

## Broken-city hunt (24 fresh random cities, plus a reach test)

- `city-audit.mjs` (my own audit, built from the game's generator in the page): **0 broken pads** in 2,206 sites. Checks: a buried landing sphere, and anything in a 1.2 m column above the pad up to the 105 m ceiling. Also an awning within the drone's radius, pads above 95 m, pads outside the city and doorsteps far from a road. The builder's `padAudit` also reports 0. 704 near misses where a cornice or awning edge sits 1.2 to 1.5 m from a pad centre: tight but flyable.
- Spawn: 0 of 24 inside geometry, 0 crashes and 0 drift in 3 s with no input.
- First pickup: 40 to 102 m straight-line from spawn, median 87 m. None absurd.
- `reach-probe.mjs` (deterministic, long clock, 10 legs a city, both bot lines): 480 legs on 24 cities. The high bot finished every leg, none over 45 s. The low bot had 4 slow legs (48 to 90 s), all stalls after leaving a tall roof. The same pads were reached in 10 to 15 s on other legs (for example 77070 Florist in 13.6 s, later 64.4 s). Shot R-low-seed48684-slowleg-9 shows the bot at 45 m beside towers. A bot problem, not a broken pad.
- No bad case needed a screenshot.

## Escalation exploits

- **Farming rush:** not possible. The game pays the bonus only on a delivery inside the window. The window is route / 11 + 5 s, tighter than the fast-drop par. The bonus is flat, with no combo and no clock time. All no-delivery farms still score 0.
- **Lazy pilot to Silver:** no. Lazy runs end at 51 to 79 s, so they see at most one rush order. It made one in 9 runs (+150 on 57366, 1,264 to 1,414). Best lazy stays 236 under Silver.
- **Rush favours the beeline.** Over 9 cities the high line made 2,100 rush points, the street line 1,350. The beeliner earns almost no street bonus and still matches the street pilot overall (14,883 vs 14,204, and 22,506 vs 21,131).
- **City reroll.** "New city" is one tap on the title and on the game-over card. Every city shares the overall best and best medal. A player can reroll until the first parcels are short. Not a bug, but it feeds the main gap below.
- **Daily memorising.** Every daily attempt gets the same parcels. That makes the daily a fair race. It is by design.

## Regressions: none found

- **Crash-classify-v, 8 seeds (11, 22, 33, 44, 7, 58, 91, 130):**
  - 12 m: 736 s, 24 deliveries, 48 charged, **0 hop-like**, 4 near the target. All were building faces 2.2 to 31 m above the drone (tops 11.7 to 39.4 m). Closest: seed 7 at 114 s, drone at 9.5 m into the depot hangar edge, top 11.7 m (N-alt12-seed7-t114.1-near). **0 on a pad lip.**
  - 20 m: 654 s, 24 deliveries, 33 charged, **0 hop-like**, 4 near (tops 10.6 to 20.2 m, drone 3.4 to 6.8 m below). **0 on a pad lip.**
  - 6 crashes rose more than 0.8 m afterwards. All had climb held during the bot's unstick move and hit walls 2.5 to 34 m below the top. Real wall hits.
- **Flat-frame probe:** 896 frames, 0 flat, 0 errors.
- **Music:** adaptive. Chain 0 to 3 gives 1 to 4 layers, mean intensity 0.34 to 0.85. Final section starts at 9.95 to 9.98 s left. 0 late notes, 0 resyncs, 0 errors. Seed 130 had 11 of 2,886 steps silent at time-up (6 last round, same moment).
- **Hand-fly first payout:** desktop 5.5 s, mobile 8.7 s, both now bank +25 (round 14: +7). Score shows the pending bonus ("1,984 +456"). Both within 10 s.
- **Page errors:** 0.

## As a player (desktop and iPhone 13 held sideways, touch)

- **Do new cities feel different?** Shuffled. The first look from the drone changes (a tower here, a park there), but the grid, the light and the mood never do. After three cities you stop noticing which one you are in. On the plus side, cities with many towers do play differently: you climb more and the street line suffers.
- **Rush hour.** Readable on desktop. A coral "RUSH HOUR" banner shows under the pill, then a "RUSH 11" tag with a bar shows in the pill. The delivery pop reads "+2,025 · Rush +150 · Street bonus +990" (H-d-seed22-t60.4, H-d-seed22-rushmade1). On iPhone held sideways the banner sits on top of the objective pill for its first second and a banked pop sits under it (H-m-seed22-t60.4). It is mildly exciting: a countdown in the pill gives the second minute a goal. But +150 is small next to a 990 street bonus. The world does not react: no traffic, no light change, only a horn. A street pilot sees 1 to 3 orders.
- **Title screen.** Clear on desktop: one-line tagline now, Play, then "City 24933 · New city · Daily city". In daily mode the label "Daily city · Thu 15 Oct" looks like a third button beside "Daily city ✓". On iPhone the city buttons are 25 px tall (below a comfortable touch size) and the daily-best line is folded into the label. The game-over card is good on both: city name, a "Rush orders 2 of 3 in time" row, "Replay this city" and "New city".

## Whole game, against the best polished indie arcade flying and delivery games

- **First 10 seconds:** strong. Golden-hour city, bold logo, one-line pitch, Play.
- **Onboarding:** good in play. First draft at 4 s, first payout +25 at 5.5 s, the score shows the pending bonus. Still many systems live in run one (bank, chain, combo, fast drop, slow clock, boost, rush).
- **Core loop:** pick up, draft, deliver, chain. Solid. But flying straight over the roofs scores as well as drafting the streets.
- **Game feel:** the best part. Momentum, banking, camera lean, crash feedback.
- **Art:** coherent, warm, finished. One mood, one palette.
- **Audio:** adaptive and clean.
- **UI:** clean. Pops still pile up at the centre at busy moments (N-alt12-seed7: Crash, Gold medal, -3 SEC and +92 banked at once).
- **Difficulty curve:** rush hour adds a small second-minute goal. No new hazard.
- **Run variety:** much better than last round in layout, still one look.
- **Game over and restart:** clear and quick, now with Replay or New city.
- **Replay pull:** the daily city with its own best is a real hook. But the medal you earn on a random city depends heavily on which city it was.

## Single biggest remaining gap: the city roll decides the medal

**The concern.** With a new random city every load, a run's score depends more on the city and its parcel draw than on the pilot. Medal lines are fixed numbers calibrated on three seeds, and the title's Best and best medal are shared by every city. So a good street pilot can get Bronze on one city and Gold on the next. A lazy pilot on an easy city can beat a good one on a hard city. Medals, the main replay pull, stop meaning skill. "New city" also lets a player reroll for an easy city.

**Evidence (this round, real-time bots):**
- Same street bot on 9 cities: 1,178 to 7,208 points, a **6.1 times** spread. Per minute 873 (70492) to 2,720 (seed 22).
- Street Silver failed on 1 of 6 random cities (70492: 1,178 Bronze).
- Best lazy run (1,414 on 57366) beats the worst street run (1,178 on 70492) by 236. On the three tuning seeds the gap was +1,579.
- On 70492 the beeline bot scores 4,525 Gold and the street bot 1,178 Bronze (3.8 times): tower-heavy cities punish the style the game's tagline asks for.
- Three runs sit within 30 of the Gold line (4,495, 4,525, 4,529).

**Acceptance test.** Use dev server 5188 and `critic-scripts/route-play-rt-x-m-esc.mjs` and `balance-probe-m-esc.mjs`. Use 12 fresh random seeds not used for tuning, read from `__GAME__.city()` after a load with no `?seed`.
1. Street (low) bot Silver or better on 12 of 12. Lazy bot Bronze or below on 12 of 12. No bot at Ace.
2. Best lazy score at least 300 below the worst street score across the 12.
3. Street bot best / worst score at most 2.5 (now 6.1).
4. Seeds 22, 58, 130 still pass the round 10 test and the no-delivery farms still score 0.
The way to get there is the builder's choice. Examples: a per-city par that scales the medal lines, no tower-heavy first legs, or best and medals kept per city or for the daily only.

## Other gaps (ranked)

1. **Cities are rearranged, not different.** Same grid, 3 parks, 6 depots, one sky and palette in all 24 audited cities. Rush hour changes a tag, not the world. Test: 6 fresh loads show at least 3 distinct city looks, for example time of day or district mix. After 60 s something visible in the world changes (traffic, lights, weather), and diagnostics count it.
2. **The beeline matches the street line.** High total 14,883 vs low 14,204 on seeds 22, 58, 130. High 22,506 vs low 21,131 on 6 random cities. The high line banks only 25 to 201 street bonus a run. Rush adds more to the high line (2,100 vs 1,350). Test: low / high at least 1.1 on 6 random cities while high still gets Silver on 5 of 6.
3. **Pops pile up at the centre.** Crash, medal, -3 SEC and banked pops at once (N-alt12-seed7-t114.1-near). On iPhone the rush banner covers the objective pill (H-m-seed22-t60.4). Test: in a full run on desktop and iPhone held sideways, no two centre pops overlap and nothing covers the objective pill.
4. **Title city controls on mobile.** Buttons 25 px tall. The daily label looks like a button next to "Daily city ✓". Test: city buttons at least 40 px tall on iPhone 13 held sideways, and the label is visibly text, not a chip.
5. **Ace still out of reach.** Best bot 7,208 (1,292 short). Best random-city run 6,781. Test: best low bot or a desktop journey within 800 of Ace.

## Performance

Headless Chromium caps at 120 Hz (8.3 ms).
- Hand-fly desktop 1280x720: 9,577 frames, **median 8.30 ms, p95 9.60, max 10.4, 0 over 20 ms**.
- Hand-fly iPhone 13 held sideways, touch: 9,581 frames, median 8.30, p95 9.60, max 10.4, 0 over 20 ms.
- First load, production build to a scratch folder: **about 0.78 MB** (JS 740 KB, 201 KB gzipped. CSS 34 KB. HTML 10 KB). lil-gui (31 KB) loads only for `?debug`. Budget 15 MB: pass.

# Drone Dash, round 15 builder: run variety

Concern from the round 14 critic: every run is the same run. With no seed, every load built seed 7 with the same first pickup, and nothing new happened after the first minute.

## Design

### 1. City variety

- **A fresh load builds a new city.** With no `?seed`, the game picks a random 5-digit seed (10000 to 99999). The title and game-over cards show "City 48213".
- **Daily city.** The title has two buttons: "New city" and "Daily city". The daily city is `?daily`. It has one seed per local calendar day (FNV hash of the date). Each daily attempt also reseeds the parcel order, so every attempt on that day gets the same city and the same parcels. The daily city keeps its own best score and medal in localStorage (`drone-dash-daily-v1`, try/catch). The overall best still counts every run. `?daily=YYYY-MM-DD` opens a given day.
- **Labels.** Title: "Daily city · Thu 15 Oct" plus "Daily best 515". On short phone screens the daily best moves into the label. Game over: the city line under "Time's up", "Daily best N" with a "New daily best!" tag.
- **Game over.** "Fly again" is now "Replay this city" (same id, `again-button`). A new "New city" button loads a random city.
- **`?seed=N` is unchanged.** The 8 test seeds give the same sites, colliders, trees and first pickup as before. I checked this by fingerprint against the unmodified generator. Seed 7 still gives fingerprint 4e56fcf3 and "Juniper Lofts Rooftop".
- **Fair pads on any seed.** New `src/world/padAudit.ts` checks every pad:
  - Buried: the drone's landing sphere overlaps a box.
  - Overhang: any collider within 1.2 m of the pad centre in the column above it (drone radius 0.95 m plus margin).
  - Awning: a drawn-only awning within 0.95 m. It has no collider, but the drone then flies through it.
  - Outside: the pad is outside the city.
  - Streets are open at every height, so a pad with a clear column is reachable. The `__GAME__.padAudit(seeds)` hook builds cities without rendering them.
- **Two generator fixes, both RNG-neutral.** Every random number is still drawn in the same order, so other cities do not change.
  - A park tree whose canopy would come within 1.2 m of the park pad is still rolled, but not planted. This affected 4 of 60 random seeds, and none of the 8 test seeds.
  - Awnings reach 0.5 m from the facade (was 1.1 m), so none hangs over a doorstep pad. Before this, 2,788 doorstep and awning overlaps were found across 68 seeds. This change is only visual.

### 2. Escalation: rush hour

- **Why rush hour.** I chose a rush order over a gust front or a closed street. It fits a street courier and the warm art style (coral is the game's existing alert colour). It does not change flight, so crash and bot behaviour stay the same.
- **When.** At 60 s of run time a "RUSH HOUR" banner shows once, with a two-note courier horn and a small camera kick. From then on, every second parcel is a rush order. From 120 s, every parcel is.
- **Rush window.** It is the leg's street route / 11 m/s + 5 s. The fast-drop par is route / 9 + 7. If a parcel is already aboard when rush hour starts, it becomes the first rush order.
- **Payout.** A rush order delivered in time pays a flat +150 (no combo). A missed window shows "Rush missed / Still deliver it", and the parcel pays as normal. Rush hour adds no clock time and never touches the objective RNG.
- **HUD.**
  - A coral "RUSH 15" tag in the objective pill, with a bar that empties and pulses in the last 5 s.
  - A coral dot, verb and nav diamond, and a coral drop beacon (`RUSH_COLOR` in ObjectiveMarker, with the same intensities, so the bloom clamps hold).
  - A "Rush order!" pop and a rising double beep on pickup.
- **Breakdown.** New "Rush orders · N of M in time" row. Rush points are inside `breakdown.fast` (and also in `breakdown.rush`), so drops + fast + combo + slip still equals the score exactly. The DOM rows still sum too: the "Fast drops" row shows fast minus rush.
- **Diagnostics.**
  - `escalation`: kind, on, startedAt, stage (0, 1 or 2), orders, made, missed, points, active, left, window.
  - `city`: mode, seed, date, dailyBest, dailyTier.
  - New scoreLog kinds: rushhour, rushorder, rush, rushmiss.

### 3. Early drafting feels paid in the moment

- The run's first payout banks at least 25 (`SLIPSTREAM.bankFirstMin`). It was about 7. It is still banked, so a run with no delivery still scores 0.
- The banked amount counts up in the pill instead of jumping.
- From the first payout, a "+60" chip sits next to the score. It is dimmer before pickup. The score no longer reads a bare 0 while you draft.
- The tagline is now one sentence.

## Acceptance results (dev server 5188, scripts in `builder-scripts/`)

`*-e.mjs` are log-only copies that add the escalation fields to the MEDAL line. Their control logic is identical to the copied scripts.

**City variety (`variety-probe.mjs`, `variety15.mjs`):** pass.
- 3 of 3 fresh loads give a different city and first pickup:
  - 528c9c2c / Fountain Park
  - dde7fc4f / Union Lofts
  - a8f4e943 / Harbor Lofts
- Daily: seed 45900 on 15 Oct in 3 of 3 loads, same fingerprint. A mocked 16 Oct gives seed 68757, a different city.
- Daily best: saved separately as `{"date":"2026-10-15","best":515}`. The title shows "Daily best 515". On the mocked next day it shows 0. A random city shows no daily line.

**Generator sweep (`pad-sweep.mjs`):** pass.
- 8 test seeds plus 40 random seeds: 4,417 pads, **0 issues**. An earlier run of 60 random seeds also had 0.
- Same seeds with both fixes switched off (`pad-sweep-before-fix.log`): 4 park-tree overhangs and 2,788 awning overlaps. This shows the audit catches problems.

**Escalation in low-bot runs:** pass.
- In all 6 low runs on 22, 58 and 130 (two passes), rush hour started at t = 60 s and shows in diagnostics.
- Rush orders per run: 1 to 3. Made: 1 to 2. Rush hour also showed in all high runs and in every lazy run that lived past 60 s.

**Round 10 test (SIMT 600):**

| Run | Seed 22 | Seed 58 | Seed 130 | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Low A | 7,151 Gold | 2,276 Silver | 4,659 Gold | 14,086 |
| Low B (music-run) | 7,244 Gold | 2,254 Silver | 4,370 Silver | 13,868 |
| High A | 4,287 Silver | 4,308 Silver | 6,082 Gold | 14,677 |
| High B | 5,737 Gold | 4,244 Silver | 3,280 Silver | 13,261 |
| Lazy A | 1,426 Bronze | 594 none | 0 none | |
| Lazy B | 1,385 Bronze | 583 none | 639 none | |

- Low / high: the worst pairing is 13,868 / 14,677 = **0.94**. Pass.
- Low: Silver 3 of 3 and Gold at least 1 in both passes. High: Silver 3 of 3 in both passes. No Ace (best 7,244). Pass.
- Breakdown exact (bdOk and domOk) in 18 of 18 runs. Lazy at Bronze or below. Pass.
- Note: the lazy bot made its rush order on seed 22 (+150), so its best rose from 1,249 to 1,426.

**Margins:** pass.
- Best lazy 1,426. Worst street 2,254 (low seed 58). Gap **828**.
- Bronze 1,000: 426 below the lazy best.
- Silver 1,650: **224** above the lazy best and **604** below the worst street.

**Untuned random seeds 51334, 19465, 79373, 85299:**

| Bot | 51334 | 19465 | 79373 | 85299 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Low | 2,008 Silver | 2,505 Silver | 6,328 Gold | 7,877 Gold |
| High | 3,621 Silver | 2,612 Silver | 3,200 Silver | 4,360 Silver |
| Lazy | 382 none | 483 none | 558 none | 0 none |

The medal lines hold off the test seeds: street at least Silver 8 of 8, lazy at most 558, no Ace (best 7,877, 623 short).

**No-delivery farms:** pass. 30 of 30 farms (farm-probe 8, farm-loop, smart-farm 21) score **0**.

**Capfarm, which delivers:**
- honest: 7,198 / 2,238 / 4,809
- carry: 2,733 / 1,108 / 0
- both: 1,483 / 1,655 / 0
- Points a minute: carry 953 and both 844, against honest 2,180, so **0.44** and **0.39**. The real-time low bot made 2,190 to 2,207 a minute.

## Regressions

- **Crash-classify-v, 8 seeds.** Vite reloaded the page after an edit and the first try died. I re-ran it.
  - 12 m: 733 s, 23 deliveries, 44 charged crashes, **0 hop-like**, 7 near the target, **0 on a pad lip**. Every near-target wall top was 5 to 20 m above the pad.
  - 20 m: 781 s, 30 deliveries, 35 charged crashes, **1 hop-like**, 3 near the target, **0 on a pad lip**. The hop-like case is seed 33 at 75.8 s, 98 m from the target. The drone was at 18.8 m and hit a face with a 23.4 m top (4.6 m under it). It lost 7.1 m/s and rose 1.0 m. It is the same kind as the single case the round 14 critic judged fair. Flight and crash code were not touched.
  - The bot is not fully repeatable: round 14 runs ranged from 819 to 847 s.
- **Flat-frame probe:** 1,039 frames, 0 flat, 0 errors.
- **Music:** music-run (low B) ran clean with adaptive music, same as round 14.
- **Hand-fly:**
  - Desktop: first draft 3.9 s, first payout 7.3 s with **+25 banked**. 9,571 frames, median 8.3 ms, **p95 9.7**, max 16.8, 0 over 20 ms.
  - Mobile: first payout 8.6 s (+25). p95 9.6, max 10.4.
- **Build:** `npm run build` passes. First load about 0.78 MB: JS 740 KB (201 KB gzip), CSS 34 KB, HTML 10 KB. lil-gui is a separate chunk.
- **Debug hooks:** kept. The bloom clamps in ObjectiveMarker are unchanged. Only the colour can switch.

## Changes made after the bot queue (HUD only)

- The "Rush order!" pop is skipped for 3.2 s after the rush hour banner, so they no longer stack (seen in `R-rush-sim-seed22-1.jpg`). If a parcel is aboard, the banner says "This parcel is a rush order".
- Short phone screens: the daily best moves into the city label. The kicker hides and the gap shrinks. The medal row and best line now fit (`V-m-title-daily.jpg`).

I checked these by rush-sim, the variety probes and the mobile shots, not by a full bot pass.

## Not done or open

- Bots rarely miss a rush window. They missed 1 in about 45 orders. It is a bonus for good routing, not yet a real squeeze for strong pilots. A tighter window (for example route / 12 + 3) needs a new balance pass.
- Medal journey and the hug probe were not re-run (not in this round's list).

## Files changed

- `src/game/cities.ts` (new): seed mode, daily seed, daily best storage, city URLs.
- `src/world/padAudit.ts` (new): pad fairness audit.
- `src/world/CityGenerator.ts`: park pad tree clearance (RNG-neutral), awning depth 0.5 m, `awnings` in the layout.
- `src/game/Game.ts`: city choice, daily reseed and best, rush hour, first payout floor, diagnostics, `padAudit` and `city` hooks.
- `src/game/config.ts`: `RUSH`, `SLIPSTREAM.bankFirstMin`.
- `src/systems/DeliverySystem.ts`: `tally.rush`, `addRush`.
- `src/entities/ObjectiveMarker.ts`: `RUSH_COLOR`, rush tint in `set`.
- `src/systems/AudioSystem.ts`: `rushHour`, `rushOrder`.
- `src/ui/Hud.ts`: city lines, rush tag, event banner, bank count-up, score pending chip, rush breakdown row.
- `index.html`, `src/styles.css`: city row, daily lines, game-over actions, rush tag, event banner, pending chip, shorter tagline.
- `src/vite-env.d.ts`: new diagnostics and hooks.

New scripts in `builder-scripts/`: `pad-sweep.mjs`, `city-fingerprint.mjs`, `variety15.mjs`, `rush-sim.mjs`, `title-mobile.mjs`, `medals.py`, `queue15.sh`, plus the `*-e.mjs` log-only copies. Screenshots are in `builder-shots/`: V-*, R-*, M-*, Q-*, d-h*, m-h*.

# Drone Dash: round 14 critic report

**Verdict:** The street bonus fixes the score. A pilot who never delivers now scores 0. Every gate in the round 13 test passes. The lazy pilot sits 800 points under the worst street run. Balance is no longer the problem. The problem now is that every run is the same run. Every load gives the same city and the same first pickup, and nothing new happens inside a run.

Build tested: the working tree at commit cf22239 plus the uncommitted round 14 changes (street bonus, Silver 1,650, Ace 8,500). Dev server port 5188. Scripts are copies of round 13 in `critic-scripts/`. Their output folder is the relative `../critic/`, so the copies write here with no edit. New scripts: `farms14.sh`, `capfarm.mjs`, `capfarm.sh`, `hug-probe-uncap.mjs`, `queue14.sh`, `variety-probe.mjs`.

## Round 13 gap (the score did not need parcels): closed

| Check | Needed | Result | Pass |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. Every 0-delivery run under 1,000 | farm-probe 8 rows, farm-loop, smart-farm near, line, pickup, pickupline, spendpickup on 22, 58, 130 | **0 in all 30 runs**. Runs last 51 to 65 s. Payouts still happen (9 to 32 a run), but the bank is never paid | Yes |
| 2. Farm at most 0.5 times the street bot a minute | | 0-delivery farms: **0 a minute**. Street bot: 2,070 (pass A) and 2,097 (pass B) a minute | Yes |
| 3. Round 10 test, two passes | see below | passes in both passes | Yes |
| 4. Lazy vs street gap at least 300, lines 150 clear | | best lazy **1,249**, worst street **2,049**: gap **800**. Silver 1,650 sits 401 above and 399 below | Yes |
| 5. Wall hug and first payout | hug at least 1.3 and 2 times, first payout within 10 s | 35 and 106 times (leg cap lifted). First payout 7.5 s desktop, 8.5 s touch | Yes |

### New farm aimed at the new rules (`capfarm.mjs`, deterministic, 600 s cap)

A routed street pilot that does deliver. In `carry` mode it picks up the parcel. Then it laps its street 2.5 m off the facade until the leg's bank is full. Then it delivers. In `both` mode it also fills the bank on the way to each pickup. `honest` is the same pilot with no farming.

| Seed | honest | carry (farm with parcel) | both (farm both legs) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 22 | 6,881 Gold, 166 s, **2,489 a min** | 2,716 Silver, 106 s, 1,531 a min | 1,483 Bronze, 83 s, 1,071 a min |
| 58 | 2,071 Silver, 92 s, **1,357 a min** | 1,091 Bronze, 77 s, 851 a min | 1,655 Silver, 81 s, 1,233 a min |
| 130 | 4,641 Gold, 135 s, **2,068 a min** | 0, 59 s (clock ran out farming) | 0, 60 s (same) |
| All | **2,081 a min** | 944 a min (**0.45**) | 843 a min (**0.41**) |

Against the real-time street bot (2,070 to 2,097 a minute), the farms make 0.40 to 0.46 times as much. Farming loses for three reasons. The clock keeps running while you circle. The drop is late, so you lose the fast bonus and the combo. A full bank that misses its drop is lost (1,244 to 1,831 points in these runs). The closest single case is seed 58 `both`: 0.91 times honest a minute, and it reached Silver by 5 points with one drop. That is a slower, worse run, not an exploit. I did not build a "nearest pair" farm: the game picks the next pickup and drop, so a player cannot choose short pairs. Very short legs bank at least 150, which an honest pilot also gets.

## Round 10 test (seeds 22, 58, 130, SIMT 600, every run twice)

| Run | Seed 22 | Seed 58 | Seed 130 | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Low A | 6,741 Gold, 159 s | 2,049 Silver, 91 s | 4,455 Silver, 134 s | 13,245 |
| Low B (music-run) | 6,894 Gold, 161 s | 2,111 Silver, 94 s | 4,451 Silver, 130 s | 13,456 |

| Lazy B | 1,212 Bronze, 2 drops | 573 none, 1 drop | 621 none, 1 drop | 2,406 |

- Low / high total: A/A 0.98, A/B 1.08, B/A 0.99, B/B 1.10 (needed 0.85). Pass.
- Low Silver 3 of 3 and Gold on seed 22, both passes. High Silver 3 of 3 both passes. No bot at Ace (best 6,894). Lazy Bronze or below in both passes. Pass.
- Breakdown exact: diagnostics and game-over card add up in 18 of 18 runs and both journeys.
- Street bonus share of a low run: 41% (seed 22), 50% (58), 54% (130). The high line drafts little (35 to 339).

| Run | Score | Nearest line | Distance |
|---|---|---|---|

The required margins hold (gap 800, Silver 401 / 399). Two notes. Low seed 130 lands 45 and 49 short of Gold in both passes: one clean leg decides it. And Ace at 8,500 is far from every run: the best bot is 1,606 short and the desktop journey 2,033 short.

## Banked bonus readability

Shots: d-h04, d-h05, m-h05, d-j22-h10-medal1, m-j22-h11-over.

- **The pill works.** Desktop: "DELIVER Bookshop · Juniper & 7th Ave **BONUS +55**" in a warm chip at the end of the objective pill. When it grows, it bumps. It sits where your eye already goes for the next stop. Good.
- **The payout pop works.** "+48 BANKED · CHAIN X2" in gold. The word "Banked" tells you the points are not in the score yet.
- **The lump on delivery works, but is soft.** "+553 STREET BONUS PAID" in teal, next to the drop pop. The score jumps from about 1,200 to 1,757 at once. That is the best moment in the new loop. But the pop is semi-transparent, sits on the drone, and fades fast. The score counter does not count up or flash for the lump.
- **Weak spots.**
  - The first payout of a run banks **+7** (desktop and touch hand-fly), the second +48. "+7" after 4 s of careful drafting feels like nothing. A slow, centred line is weighted down to 0.2, which is right for balance and wrong for the first impression.
  - The score reads **0** for the whole first leg (26 s in the desktop hand-fly), while the pill shows a growing bonus. A new player can think that drafting does nothing.
  - On iPhone 13 held sideways, the pill drops the word "Bonus" and shows only "+64" after the street name. Without the label it reads like a distance or a price.
- **Does drafting still feel rewarding in the moment?** Mostly yes. The boost bar refills. The chain adds music layers, from 1 to 4. The camera shakes. The badge reads "CLOCK FROZEN" with a bar that empties. The points themselves now feel like a promise, not a reward. With a hard crash cutting the bank ("bonus -N"), carrying a fat bonus gives real stakes. That is a good change.
- The round 13 "three seconds numbers" problem is gone. The badge now says "CLOCK FROZEN" with a small bar, and the pop no longer says "CLOCK +2S".

## Whole game, as a player

Against the best polished indie arcade flying and delivery games I know.

- **First 10 seconds.** Strong. Golden-hour city from above, bold logo, medal ladder, a sound prompt. The tagline is still three sentences of rules.
- **Onboarding.** Good in action. The first draft comes at 4 s and the first payout at 7.5 s (desktop) or 8.5 s (touch). The hint "Faster & closer to walls fills it faster" shows at the right moment. Weak in words: medals, combo, fast drops, chain, hug, boost, slow clock, budget, wrong way and now the bank are all live in run one.
- **Core loop.** Now one loop. Pick up, draft along the streets to grow the bonus, deliver to cash it, keep the combo. Drafting and delivering finally point the same way. This is the biggest step in many rounds.
- **Game feel.** Still the best part: momentum, banking, a camera that leans, clear crashes with "-3 SEC".
- **Art.** Coherent, warm, finished low-poly. But it is one city, seen the same way every time.
- **Audio.** Adaptive and clean. Chain 0 to 3 goes from intensity 0.35 to 0.86 and from 1 to 4 layers. The final section starts at 9.96 to 9.99 s left. 0 late notes, 0 resyncs, 0 errors.
- **UI.** Clean and on-style. The game-over card adds up and now says "Street bonus paid on 4 drops · 360 lost", which teaches the rule after the fact. The payout pop still sits on the drone.
- **Difficulty curve and run length.** 1:30 to 2:45 for good pilots, about 1:05 to 1:20 for a lazy one. Good length. But the only thing that changes inside a run is that the next pickup can be up to 155 m away instead of 95 m. No new hazard, no traffic in the air, no rush hour, no weather, no new district.
- **Game over and restart.** Clear and quick.
- **Replay pull.** Medals now mean courier skill, which is good. But the next run is the same city, the same first pickup, and the same two minutes. Ace at 8,500 has no visible path: the best run here is 1,606 short.

## Single biggest remaining gap: every run is the same run

**The concern.** The city is fixed and a run never changes. With no `?seed`, every page load builds seed 7: the same 88 sites in the same places, and the first pickup is "Juniper Lofts Rooftop" every time. Inside a run, nothing new appears after the first minute. The best arcade games of this kind change the board: daily routes, new districts, weather, traffic, a rush hour. Or they change the run as it goes. Here, once you have flown the city twice, you have seen the game.

**Evidence (this round):**
- `variety-probe.mjs`: 3 fresh loads with no seed give the **same city fingerprint (4e56fcf3) and the same first pickup** 3 of 3 times.
- `DEFAULT_SEED = 7` in the game, and the only in-run change is the next pickup range (95 m growing by 5 m a drop, to 155 m).
- In all 18 bot runs and both journeys, the second minute holds the same things as the first: pads, buildings, a clock. Not one new element.
- Fourteen rounds tuned scoring, clock and balance. With round 14, balance holds within every target (above), so more tuning will not move the game much.

**Acceptance test** (dev server 5188):
1. Run `variety-probe.mjs`. At least 2 of 3 fresh loads give a different city fingerprint or district. Another way to pass: the title shows a named daily city with its own best score. With a mocked date, 2 dates give 2 fingerprints.
2. Run the low bot on seeds 22, 58 and 130. In 3 of 3 runs, a new gameplay element appears after 60 s. Examples: traffic drones, a rush-hour headwind, a moving pickup, a closed street. The diagnostics show it, for example as a hazard count that rises after 60 s.
3. The round 14 gates still pass. 0-delivery farms score under 1,000. The round 10 test passes twice. The lazy-to-street gap is at least 300, with Silver 150 clear of both. The first payout comes within 10 s. The hand-fly runs have 0 frames over 20 ms.

## Other gaps (ranked)

1. **The first leg feels like it pays nothing.** The first payout banks +7. The score reads 0 until the first drop, 26 s into the desktop hand-fly. Test: in the hand-fly run, the first banked pop shows at least +25. Or, from the first payout on, the score shows the pending bonus (for example "0 +55").
2. **Ace looks out of reach.** Best bot 6,894 (1,606 short), desktop journey 6,467 (2,033 short). Test: the best of the low bots and the desktop journey reaches within 800 of Ace, or a human playtest reaches Ace once in 5 runs.
3. **One leg still decides Gold on seed 130.** Low runs land 45 and 49 short in both passes. Test: no route-bot result within 100 of a line in two passes.
4. **The pop sits on the drone, and the paid lump is soft.** See the desktop and touch shots. "+553 STREET BONUS PAID" is semi-transparent over the drone. Test: in a full run, no payout or paid pop overlaps the drone's screen box. The score counter animates the paid lump.
5. **Too many rules in run one, and the mobile pill drops its label.** The tagline is three sentences. The touch pill shows only "+64". Test: the tagline is one sentence, and the touch pill shows "Bonus" or an icon next to the number.

## Regressions: none found

- **Hug probe** (seed 22, roads -22, 22, 66, `hug-probe-uncap.mjs` with the leg cap lifted. The capped probe never picks up, so the cap hides the difference): centre at cruise / centre at 9 m/s = 742 / 21 = **35** (needed 1.3). Hug at cruise / centre at 9 m/s = 2,226 / 21 = **106** (needed 2). Payout counts: 5 vs 2 and 10 vs 2. 0 crashes.
- **First payout:** desktop 7.5 s into the run, 3.5 s after the first draft. Touch 8.5 s, 4.0 s after. Both within 10 s.
- **Crash-classify-v, 8 seeds (11, 22, 33, 44, 7, 58, 91, 130):**
  - 12 m: 847 s, 30 deliveries, 46 charged crashes, **0 hop-like**. 9 near the target, all street pads (0.4 to 0.5 m). Every one hit a building face whose top was 1.8 to 51 m above the drone (wall tops 8.8 to 58.6 m). **0 on a pad lip.** Example: seed 7 at 32 s, the drone at 0.8 m beside the pad flew into a house front with an 8.8 m top (N-alt12-seed7-t32.0-near). As a player that charge is fair: you flew into a wall.
  - 20 m: 713 s, 25 deliveries, 27 charged, **1 hop-like**: seed 130 at 32.6 s, at 20.2 m into a face with a 33 m top, lost 8.8 m/s, rose 1.2 m. Same case as rounds 12 and 13: a real wall hit, 12.8 m below the top. Fair. 1 near the target (seed 22, street pad, face top 10.6 m, drone at 5.4 m). **0 on a pad lip.**
- **Flat-frame probe:** 1,041 frames, **0 flat**, 0 errors.
- **Music:** adaptive (see Audio). Seed 130 had 6 of 2,859 steps with no music, at time-up, as before.
- **Medal journey:** desktop 6,467 Gold, mobile 4,736 Gold. Both below Ace.
- **Page errors:** 0 on desktop and mobile.

## Performance

Headless Chromium caps at 120 Hz (8.3 ms).
- Hand-fly desktop 1280x720: 9,576 frames, **median 8.30 ms, p95 9.80, max 10.4, 0 over 20 ms**.
- Hand-fly iPhone 13 held sideways, touch: 9,578 frames, median 8.30, p95 9.70, max 10.4, 0 over 20 ms.

# Drone Dash, round 14 builder: the street bonus

Concern from the round 13 critic: the score did not need parcels. Slipstream payouts scored on their own, so a no-delivery wall farm made about 3,400 points a minute and reached Silver every time.

## Design

Slipstream points now come in only through the parcel.

- **Banked, not scored.** Each slip payout banks points into a "street bonus" for the current parcel run. The score does not move. The pop near the drone says "+37" with "Banked · chain x2".
- **Paid on delivery.** On a drop the whole bank is paid at once. The centre pop shows the total, for example "+812" over "Fast drop · x2.0 combo · street bonus +412". A teal "+412 Street bonus paid" pop shows at the drone.
- **Lost if not delivered.** At time-up, the bank is lost. A hard crash or a wreck (crash tier 1 and up) halves the bank, and the crash pop says "bonus -N". The crash clock and combo rules are unchanged.
- **Rates.**
  - With a parcel aboard, a payout banks its full points. On the way to a pickup it banks 0.75 of them, and that bank rides on the parcel you pick up.
  - New: a pace weight. Each payout is multiplied by the meter's mean fill rate while it filled (draft metres a second, the same measure as the HUD chevrons). The weight is 0.2 at 2.5 m/s or less, 1 at 6, and at most 2.5. A slow centred crawl banks a fifth. A fast line along the facades banks 1.5 to 2.5 times.
  - Balance bots: the lazy flier's payouts average a pace of about 3. The routed street bot's run from 4 to 14.
- **Leg cap.** Each leg banks at most 7 points per metre of its street route (grid distance), and at least 150. Honest street legs reached at most 6 per metre on the bots. The cap stops "carry a parcel and circle a wall" from paying without limit.
- **Unchanged.** The meter, chain, chain audio and adaptive music stay. Each payout still refills boost. The round 12 to 13 slow clock rules stay: only toward the objective, 8 s budget per leg.
- **HUD.**
  - A small "BONUS +208" chip at the end of the objective pill. On phones it shows only "+208". At 0 it is hidden. It bumps when it grows. Before pickup it is dimmer.
  - New title tagline: it now says the slipstream banks a street bonus that a delivery pays.
- **One seconds number.** The timer is now the only seconds figure on screen.
  - The badge says "SLOW CLOCK", "CLOCK FROZEN", "SLOW CLOCK SPENT" or "SLOW CLOCK: WRONG WAY". The leg's budget shows as a small bar that empties, with no "7S".
  - The payout pop no longer shows "clock +Ns".
  - Badge text is 12.5 px on desktop (was 9.9) and 10.6 px on a sideways phone. The centre column gap grew from 8 to 14 px so the badge sits clear between the timer and the pill.
- **Breakdown.** The "Slipstream" row is now "Street bonus" (paid points), with detail such as "paid on 5 drops · 177 lost". The lost amount is shown but not added in. The rows still sum exactly. The clock line is unchanged.

## Acceptance results (dev server 5188, scripts in `builder-scripts/`)

**1. Zero-delivery runs score under 1,000.** Pass. All score **0**.
- farm-probe, all 8 rows: 0. They are still 58 s long with 8 s of slow clock, as before.
- farm-loop seed 22: 0.
- smart-farm on seeds 22, 58 and 130: `near` 0/0/0 and `line` 0/0/0. `pickupline` and `spendpickup` (roads 66 and -22): 0 in all 12 runs.

**2. Farm points a minute are at most 0.5 times the street bot's.** Pass. The farms make 0 a minute. The street bot makes 2,124 (pass A) and 2,113 (pass B).

**3. Round 10 test, two passes (SIMT 600):**

| Run | Seed 22 | Seed 58 | Seed 130 | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Low A | 6,882 Gold | 2,046 Silver | 4,594 Gold | 13,522 |
| Low B (music-run) | 6,927 Gold | 2,088 Silver | 4,476 Silver | 13,491 |
| High A | 5,428 Gold | 4,074 Silver | 4,859 Gold | 14,361 |
| High B | 6,732 Gold | 4,069 Silver | 3,945 Silver | 14,746 |
| Lazy A | 1,249 Bronze | 516 none | 626 none | 2,391 |
| Lazy B | 1,220 Bronze | 520 none | 0 none | 1,740 |

- Low / high totals: worst pairing 13,491 / 14,746 = **0.91**, so all pairings are at least 0.91. Pass.
- Low: Silver 3 of 3 and Gold at least 1 in both passes. Pass.
- High: Silver 3 of 3 in both passes. Pass.
- No route bot at Ace: the best is 6,927, and Ace is now 8,500. Pass.
- Breakdown exact: diagnostics and game-over DOM add up in 18 of 18 runs. Pass.
- Lazy at Bronze or below in both passes. Pass.
- The high bot ran stronger this round (seed 22 base 5,389 to 6,609, against 3,618 to 3,962 in round 13). This is bot variance. Its street bonus is small: 36 to 487.
- Lazy B seed 130 scored 0: 0 deliveries in that real-time pass.
- Points a minute, lazy / low: 0.31 (pass A) and 0.25 (pass B).

**4. Margins.** Pass.
- The best lazy run is 1,249 and the worst street run is 2,046. They are **797** apart.
- Bronze 1,000 is 249 below the lazy best and 1,046 below the street worst.
- Silver 1,650 (was 1,600) is **401** above the lazy best and **396** below the street worst.
- Gold 4,500 and Ace 8,500 are far from both.
- Not required, but note: low seed 130 straddles Gold (4,476 and 4,594), and two high runs sit near Gold (4,069 to 4,074).

**5. Wall hug and first payout.** Pass.
- Wall hug. The plain hug-probe passes, but its numbers are flattened by the leg cap: the probe never picks up, so the 38 m pickup leg caps the bank at 266. Road 66: centre at cruise / centre at 9 m/s = 266 / 21 = 12.7. Hug at cruise / centre at 9 m/s = 669 / 21 = 32.
- With the cap off (`hug-probe-uncap.mjs`): centre at cruise 735 to 752, hug at cruise 2,224 to 2,226, centre at 9 m/s 21. That gives 35x and 106x.
- First payout. Desktop: 1.5 s after the first draft (5.5 s into the run). Mobile: 3.2 s after (7.2 s). Both show a visible "+7 / Banked · street bonus" pop, and the objective pill chip shows "BONUS +7" (see `d-h04-low-payout-pop.jpg`, `m-h05-low-payout-chain.jpg`). The first banked amount is small because the intro payout is slow (pace weight 0.2).

## Regressions

- **Crash-classify, 8 seeds.**
  - 12 m: 819 s, 27 deliveries, 51 charged crashes, **0 hop-like**. 6 were within 30 m of the target. One needs a look: seed 7 at 71.45 s, Bay Lofts Rooftop (pad 32.5 m). The drone was climbing (climb held) at y 28.4, skids about 5.5 m under the 33 m roof edge, and hit the facade. The pad-edge rule exempts only hits within 4 m of the edge, so this was charged as a real face hit. The other 5 hit faces with tops 7.4 to 39.4 m over street pads.
  - 20 m: 792 s, 30 deliveries, 32 charged, **0 hop-like**, 3 near the target, **0 on a pad lip**.
  - Crash and flight code were not touched this round.
- **Flat-frame probe:** 979 frames, 0 flat, 0 errors.
- **Music:** adaptive. Chain 0 to 3 goes from intensity 0.33 to 0.65 or more, and from 1 to 3 or more layers. At most 6 steps had no music, at time-up.
- **Medal journey:** desktop 6,903 Gold and mobile 2,919 Silver. Both are below Ace.
- **Performance:**
  - Desktop journey: median 8.3 ms, **p95 9.8**, max 18.0, 0 over 20 ms.
  - Mobile journey: p95 9.8, max 10.4.
  - Hand-fly: desktop p95 9.7, mobile p95 9.9.
- **Build:** `npm run build` is OK. JS is 730 KB (198 KB gzipped).
- Bloom clamps in ObjectiveMarker.ts are untouched. The debug hooks are kept, and the diagnostics gained `slipstream.bank/bankTotal/bankPaid/bankLost/legBanked/legCap` and `scoreLog`.

## Not done / open

- A one-delivery farm (carry a parcel, hug a wall, then deliver) was not probed. The leg cap limits it to 7 points per metre of the leg's street route, plus the drop. On a 100 to 250 m leg that is about 700 to 1,800.
- Medals now often arrive in lumps on delivery. Bronze and Silver were passed on the same drop in several runs, and the HUD shows both.
- Silver was changed from 1,600 to 1,650 after the bot passes. Medal lines do not affect flight, and no run scored between 1,600 and 1,650, so the logged medals stand.

## Files changed

- `src/game/config.ts`: SLIPSTREAM bank settings, Silver 1,650, Ace 8,500, comments.
- `src/game/Game.ts`: bank, pace weight, leg cap, paid on delivery, crash cut, pops, game-over fields, diagnostics, scoreLog.
- `src/systems/Slipstream.ts`: payout event carries `pace`.
- `src/systems/DeliverySystem.ts`: delivered event carries `legTime` and `par` (log only).
- `src/ui/Hud.ts`: `setBank`, new `slipPop` signature, badge words and budget bar, "Street bonus" breakdown row.
- `index.html`: bonus chip, badge text and bar spans, tagline.
- `src/styles.css`: chip, badge size and bar, centre gap, paid pop.
- `src/vite-env.d.ts`: diagnostics types.

## Scripts

All in `progress/round-14/builder-scripts/`. They are copies of the round 13 critic scripts, with output going to `../builder-shots/`.

- New: `tune-play.mjs`, a deterministic route bot. It uses `externalClock`, takes CRUISE, NOBOOST and UNCAP, and dumps the scoreLog.
- New: `rescore.mjs` and `grid.py` for offline rescoring.
- New: `farms14.sh`, `queue14.sh`, `summarize.py`, `hug-probe-uncap.mjs`.

- Note: earlier tune runs in `tune/` and `tune2/` were not deterministic, because the page also ran in real time. Ignore them.
